title: blahblahblah.design: one word set by fifty designers
note: Each tile is the word blah set by a different designer, in black and white: stencil, scribble, pixels, ASCII, 3D, rotated stamps. Under each tile are the designer's name and Read ↗. The grid stays strict so the type can be wild. Worth taking: when the content is varied, the system around it can be dead simple.
